title: Model external enterprise control evidence
rawUserRequest: Complete all governed Work Items. For WI-17, model enterprise controls as external observed evidence, never as repository-created compliance; do not modify provider configuration.

rawRequestSource.reference: active user goal and AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instructions, WI-17

declaredIntent.summary: Replace ambiguous enterprise-control status labels with auditable, time-bound observed-control evidence that keeps the repository/provider boundary explicit.

outOfScope: Provider configuration, IdP configuration, branch-protection changes, secret-manager configuration, production isolation, and external compliance certification.
Claims that this repository is compliant, enterprise-ready, or externally verified.

sources.reason: Repository-maintained remediation context for the enterprise-control boundary; the active human request supplies the current WI-17 requirements.
Existing boundary inventory to migrate to observed-control evidence.
Existing adopter handoff boundary to retain and clarify.

riskAssessment.reason: A misleading control state could be read as an external compliance assertion; evidence must be explicit, time-bound, and fail closed.

reasons: Enterprise-control claims require explicit boundary and evidence verification.

override.approvalEvidence: User authorized governed Contract and Work Item writes in this thread.
override.reason: Strict review for a public governance boundary without an external control operation.
notRunChecks: External provider control verification is out of scope and must remain not_verified.

executionDecision.reason: The task changes repository-local schema, validation, tests, and documentation only; it does not configure or assert external controls.

preReviewWarnings: Do not infer provider facts from local Git, CI, or checklist text; do not retain a generic compliant or verified aggregate verdict.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Every control record carries provider, resource, requiredState, observedState, evidenceType, verifiedAt, owner, limitation, and expiresAt fields.
Missing external evidence evaluates only to not_verified with an explicit limitation; no aggregate compliant verdict is representable.
The control inventory covers identity, authorization, branch protection, review policy, secrets, audit, signing, SBOM, provenance, retention, separation of duties, and production isolation.
Validation rejects forbidden compliant/verified vocabulary, expired evidence, incomplete records, and attempted provider-fact inference from repository-local evidence.
Documentation separates an adopter checklist from observed evidence and preserves the external-control boundary.
guidelines: Keep repository-local evidence distinct from external provider and enterprise-control evidence.
Use fail-closed states and explicit limitations rather than aggregate compliance claims.
Do not change provider configuration or historical archived Work Items.

intent.problem: The existing enterprise-control matrix mixes checklist-oriented labels such as verified with repository-local boundary text, without the required auditable evidence fields. This can be misread as an enterprise compliance result.
constraints: No external provider, identity, or production configuration changes.
No compliant or aggregate verified verdict.
Repository-local facts cannot be promoted to external control evidence.
Do not rewrite archived Work Items.
intent.rationale: A typed observed-control evidence record makes missing, expired, and limited external evidence legible while preserving a useful adopter handoff checklist.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A control with no external evidence remains not_verified and explains the missing evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Unit tests for evaluator and matrix validation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Expired or incomplete observed evidence is rejected rather than producing a positive control state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Unit tests with expired and missing-field fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A local repository receipt cannot be treated as external provider evidence or a compliant verdict.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Regression tests for evidence provenance and forbidden verdict vocabulary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The documented inventory remains a checklist while observed evidence stays separately queryable.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized governed Contract and Work Item writes.

humanDecisionPoints: An adopter or provider administrator must supply current external evidence before any control can be reported as observed; this Work Item does not make that decision.
requiredEvidence: Full governed verification and hosted PR CI.
rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff; no provider or production state is changed.
